usages.explain: Represents something that cannot be done at the moment but the speaker will try to do it in the future.

examples.content: 日本語でまだ歌えません。
examples.transcription: にほんごでまだうたえません。
examples.mean: I can't sing in Japanese yet.

examples.content: 英語がまだ上手に話せません。
examples.transcription: えいごがまだじょうずにはなせません。
examples.mean: I still can't speak English well.

title: まだV-られない => Not yet ~
